cardSchemes.description: List of card schemes supported for this merchant. Supported values are VISA, MASTERCARD, MAESTRO, AMEX, DCI, DISCOVER.

wallets.description: List of payment wallets supported for this merchant. Supported values are APPLE_PAY, GOOGLE_PAY.

cv2.description: The CV2 code associated with the card from the original transaction. Note that if using this you need to be PCI SAQ-D compliant

statusCode.description: * `0` - Successful * `3` - Authorizing * `4` - Referred * `5` - Declined * `20` - Duplicate Transaction * `30` - Failed * `40` - Processing * `90` - Revoked * `99` - Waiting pre-execute More details here

crossReference.description: Code to be passed to /v1/cross-reference-payments, this code does not have an expiry date.

cardNumber.description: Masked card number used in the transaction.

cardName.description: Card name used in the transaction.

expiryDate.description: Expiry date used in the transaction.

cardType.description: Card type used in the transaction.

userEmailAddress.description: User email associated with this transaction

metaData.description: String key value pairs passed when creating the access token.

merchantUrl.description: The URL of the merchant's website used ensure the correct JWT is used. This needs to match what it provided when setting up an account

currencyCode.description: The three digit ISO- 4217 currency code for the currency. eg 826 for the United Kingdom

amount.description: The amount in the minor unit e.g. '100' for 1.00 GBP

transactionType.description: The type of transaction to be processed. If making a web payment only SALE and PREAUTH are supported. If making a cross reference payment only COLLECTION, REFUND, VOID, PREAUTH or SALE are supported

transactionSource.description: Specify if the source of the transaction is MOTO (via mail or over the phone)

orderId.description: A merchant side ID for the order

merchantTransactionId.description: Merchant generated transaction ID to uniquely identify the transaction. If included must be unique for each access token.

userAgent.description: Not supported for cross reference transactions.

userEmailAddress.description: Not supported for cross reference transactions.

userPhoneNumber.description: Not supported for cross reference transactions.

userIpAddress.description: Not supported for cross reference transactions.

userAddress1.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userAddress2.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userAddress3.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userAddress4.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userCity.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userState.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userPostcode.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

userCountryCode.description: If any address field is provided for a cross reference transaction all address fields will be overridden.

newTransaction.description: Treat the transaction as a new transaction. Default is false and is only supported by cross reference transactions.

crossReference.description: The cross reference from a previous transaction to be used with customer present recurring transactions.

webHookUrl.description: Url to be called once the transaction is complete.

metaData.description: String key value pairs to associate with the transaction. Will be passed back on the Payment Details API. Not used in processing.

waitPreExecute.description: Pause the transaction before the payment is executed, after any payer authentication (such as 3DS) has been completed.

customerId.description: Customer Id used to enable save payment method feature.

expiresAt.description: UTC timestamp when this token will expire (Number of seconds since Jan 01 1970. (UTC))
